name: Victoria High School
scope: Standing Victoria High School at 1260 Grant Street, including the restored original school, 1955 and 2011 attachments, and the 2024 additions within the mapped building envelope.
era: Current main building after the 2024 rehabilitation and expansion

externalReferences.title: The new high school at Fernwood Road and Grant Street
externalReferences.artist: Uncredited period illustration in the Victoria Daily Times

originalReview.notes: The period rendering of the actual Grant Street design shows the central three-bay colonnade and stairs, side frontispieces, large repeated window groups, low parapets and roof ventilators.

review.notes: Checked the Qualla story imagery first. The actual school views require attribution and its public-domain images depict other sites. The original 1912 newspaper page qualifies through the issue date and the archive’s public-domain record. It establishes the historic frontage. Modern changes use documented factual descriptions and the current map.
